fixes.explanation: Wrong direction, friend. The Servant is appointed "to say to the prisoners, 'Come out'" (Isaiah 49:9). Nobody sitting in the dark has ever heard "Stay put" and said, "Oh, thank goodness, I was hoping for that." I've heard plenty of nothing in a dark drawer, and "Come out" would have been the best thing I ever heard.

No storm in this verse, friend. The LORD says, "Behold, they will come from far away, from the north and from the west, and from the land of Aswan." (Isaiah 49:12). I get it, "Behold" sounds like a weather alert, and I'd have grabbed an umbrella too. But what comes into view is people, and they're coming from a long way off.
